## Documentation checklist

- [ ] Subsystem doc updated (status, interfaces, how to run)
- [ ] Experiment record / results added if something was tested
- [ ] DDR written if a design decision was made
- [ ] Dataset card or model card updated if data or a model changed
- [ ] Requirements / traceability updated if a requirement's status changed
- [ ] BOM updated if parts were added or bought
- [ ] Not applicable: this change doesn't affect any docs
